dt: FY2025 NOFO (2025-NIST-MSE-01) closed Sept 15, 2026. A successor NOFO is usually posted each year.
e: A standing NOFO for research with NIST laboratories in metrology, nanotechnology, AI, advanced communications and manufacturing, neutron research and related areas. It is open to universities and other non-federal organizations. Contacting a NIST program contact first is usual.
n: NIST Measurement Science and Engineering (MSE) Research Grant Programs
unv: The successor NOFO has not been posted yet.
